claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For all genuine Boolean children g,h and a fresh uniform selector F, U(F)-[U(g)+U(h)]/2 <= -V(F)+[V(g)+V(h)]/2+L((g-h)/2)+(3/ln2)Pr[g!=h], where V=H-U and L is raw spectral entropy.

claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: On every finite binary physical restriction tree with node-unique fresh selectors and arbitrary fully shared Boolean terminal cores, the weighted sum of upper-set node charges is at most terminal weighted H-U minus root H-U, plus one weighted raw child-difference entropy packet per node, plus (3/ln2) times total physical selector influence.
claims.scope: Arbitrary depth and dyadic reach probabilities; arbitrary terminal bias, overlap, and spectra. Reused physical selector coordinates are excluded.

claims.label: OPEN
claims.statement: There is a dimension-independent payment of sum_v w_v L((F_v^- - F_v^+)/2) by nonreused physical data influence and terminal entropy for arbitrary changing-core hierarchies.
claims.known_obstruction: The sparse bent-surgery family forbids replacing this retained packet by C times selector influence, already at depth one.
